segments.text: EIP-8024. Three new stack opcodes. Glamsterdam is coming.
Solidity developers know this one — stack too deep.
DUPN, SWAPN, and EXCHANGE let the EVM reach deeper into the stack.
Watch the stack grow — seventeen values pushed.
Now DUPN copies from depth seventeen. No compiler gymnastics.
Peek at the companion — a magic-byte calculator for these opcodes.
Classic DUP stops at depth sixteen. You just copied depth seventeen.
Read the EIP on Forkcast. Explore it on Feel Your Protocol.
